<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReorderRequest" name="Product reorder request" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty demand" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" />

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order to process">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ReadOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ReadOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check whether product is in stock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock" name="Product in stock?" default="Flow_Stock_Reorder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Withdraw</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Withdraw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Withdraw_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reorder_EventGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ArrivalOrDelay" name="Wait for arrival or 10 days" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reorder_EventGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EventGateway_ArrivedInTime</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EventGateway_Delay</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrivedInTime" name="Product arrives within 10 days">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EventGateway_ArrivedInTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArrivedInTime_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArrivalInTime" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_TenDaysElapsed" name="10 days elapsed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EventGateway_Delay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TenDays_Penalty</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_TenDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT10D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Demand delivery delay penalty from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TenDays_Penalty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Penalty_WaitArrival</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrivedAfterDelay" name="Product arrives after 10 days">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Penalty_WaitArrival</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArrivedAfterDelay_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArrivalAfterDelay" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArrivedInTime_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArrivedAfterDelay_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductPathsMerge" name="Continue product processing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Withdraw_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_CheckReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReady" name="Check whether whole order is ready for shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_CheckReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckReady_ReadyGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Whole order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_OrderNotReady_SelectNext">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckReady_ReadyGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderReady_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderNotReady_SelectNext</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderNotReady_SelectNext</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentPreparationSplit" name="Prepare shipment in parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderReady_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_RequestCourier</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_PackProducts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_RequestCourier</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestCourier_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_PackProducts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackProducts_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentPreparationJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestCourier_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackProducts_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Ship</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Ship</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckStock" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_Stock" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Withdraw" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>product is in stock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Reorder" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_Merge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductPathsMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_EventGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalOrDelay" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EventGateway_ArrivedInTime" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalOrDelay" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivedInTime" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EventGateway_Delay" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalOrDelay" targetRef="Event_TenDaysElapsed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivedInTime_Register" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrivedInTime" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TenDays_Penalty" sourceRef="Event_TenDaysElapsed" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_WaitArrival" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivedAfterDelay" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivedAfterDelay_Register" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrivedAfterDelay" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductPathsMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_CheckReady" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductPathsMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReady_ReadyGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady_ParallelSplit" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentPreparationSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>whole order is ready for shipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady_SelectNext" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckStock" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_Join" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentPreparationJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentPreparationJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentPreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderRequest" name="Product reorder request" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrivalInTime" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivedInTime" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrivalAfterDelay" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivedAfterDelay" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty demand" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
